# nuclis

> A local inference engine for open-weight language models on Apple Silicon, written from scratch in Zig with a Metal backend, with a small coding agent (`nuclis agent`) and typed decision models (`nuclis decide`, `nuclis serve`) on top. Every layer is checked against a pinned llama.cpp build before it is optimized. MIT licensed; experimental, version 0.x.

- Runs on macOS on Apple Silicon. Download a release binary or build with Zig 0.17.0.
- Models are pinned to a repository, commit and SHA-256: Qwen3.8 27B, Gemma 4 (12B QAT, 26B-A4B, E4B QAT), Muse Glimmer 30B, and the decision models Laya and clef-flash.
- Speculative decoding is on by default where it measured faster.
